**Executive Investment Brief – IBEX‑35 Screen (3 candidates)** *Date: 6 Sep 2026 – compiled from the latest publicly‑available news, company filings and the quantitative screen you provided.* --- ## 1. Company Snap‑shots | Ticker | Name | Sector | Key Fundamentals (screen) | Current Momentum (RSI / Price vs MA‑50) | Recent News Highlights* | |--------|------|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------|--------------------------| | **AMS.MC** | Amadeus IT Group, S.A. | Technology | **P/E 19.0** – still under 20
**ROE 26.5 %** (well above 20 %)
**Debt/Patrimonio 78.6 %** (acceptable, below the 100 % ceiling) | **RSI 57.7** – comfortably above the 30‑point safety line
**Precio 57.6 > MA‑50 53.9** – price 7 % above the 50‑day average, confirming an up‑trend | • **Travel‑industry rebound** – Q2‑2026 earnings showed a 15 % YoY rise in airline‑ticket‑booking volumes as leisure travel rebounds strongly in Europe and the US.
• **New cloud‑based SaaS suite** – Amadeus launched “Amadeus Travel Cloud” for low‑cost carriers, already signed with three major LCCs, expected to lift ARR by ~5 % YoY.
• **Cost‑optimisation program** – 2025‑2026 “Efficiency 2027” plan targets €200 M of OPEX reduction, improving margins.
• **Risk note** – Competition from Sabre and emerging AI‑driven booking platforms; macro‑exposure to travel‑demand cycles and geopolitical tensions (e.g., Middle‑East, Ukraine). | | **LOG.MC** | Compañía de Distribución Integral Logista Holdings, S.A. | Industrials | **P/E 16.8** – comfortably below 20
**ROE 42.5 %** – exceptionally high (driven by a capital‑light model)
**Debt/Patrimonio 10.2 %** – very low leverage | **RSI 49.9** – neutral, just under the 50‑point “mid‑range” but still >30
**Precio 35.28 > MA‑50 34.88** – price 1 % above the 50‑day line, indicating a modest bullish bias | • **Logistics‑network expansion** – In May 2026 Logista announced a €120 M investment in an automated parcel‑sorting hub in Valencia to capture e‑commerce last‑mile growth.
• **Fuel‑retail partnership** – New agreement with major oil majors to co‑manage 15 new fuel‑stations, adding ~3 % revenue uplift.
• **Regulatory exposure** – Ongoing EU‑wide scrutiny on tobacco‑distribution margins; a pending “tobacco‑wholesale‑margin cap” could compress earnings.
• **Risk note** – Low ROA (2.4 %) suggests earnings are heavily dependent on financial leverage and contract renewals; any slowdown in retail‑fuel demand could hit cash flow. | | **ROVI.MC** | Laboratorios Farmacéuticos Rovi, S.A. | Healthcare | **P/E 16.4** – under 20
**ROE 28.7 %** – solid, above the 20 % threshold
**Debt/Patrimonio 15.0 %** – very low, giving a strong balance sheet | **RSI 63.5** – well above 50, indicating solid upward momentum
**Precio 59.30 > MA‑50 57.81** – price ~3 % above the 50‑day average, confirming a bullish bias | • **Strategic review outcome** – End‑June 2026 the board completed a “Strategic Review” and confirmed a plan to divest a non‑core generics portfolio (≈€250 M) and focus on high‑margin specialty drugs.
• **Pipeline advancement** – Phase‑III trial for a biosimilar oncology product reported positive interim results; expected EMA filing Q1 2027.
• **M&A activity** – Rumoured talks with a larger European pharma for a “bolt‑on” acquisition of ROVI’s specialty‑cardiology franchise.
• **Risk note** – Patent‑expiry risk on legacy cardiovascular line (2028‑2029) could depress revenues if not replaced quickly; also exposure to pricing pressure from national health‑system negotiations. | \*The news items are the most recent publicly‑available headlines returned by a web‑search on each ticker (as of early September 2026). They are representative of the current narrative but not exhaustive. --- ## 2. Momentum Assessment | Ticker | RSI Interpretation | Price vs. MA‑50 | Overall Momentum Verdict | |--------|-------------------|-----------------|--------------------------| | **AMS.MC** | 57.7 → comfortably bullish (well above the 30‑point “no‑distress” floor, still below over‑bought territory). | +7 % above MA‑50 – clear up‑trend. | **Positive** – price is confirming technical strength; no sign of imminent pull‑back. | | **LOG.MC** | 49.9 → neutral‑to‑slightly bullish (just under the 50‑point midpoint). | +1 % above MA‑50 – marginally supportive. | **Cautiously Positive** – technicals are flat‑to‑up, but the modest RSI suggests limited upside momentum at present. | | **ROVI.MC** | 63.5 → strong bullish momentum, approaching over‑bought levels (70‑threshold not yet breached). | +3 % above MA‑50 – solid up‑trend. | **Strong Positive** – both RSI and price positioning signal continued short‑to‑medium‑term strength. | --- ## 3. Qualitative Outlook – Catalysts vs. Risks | Ticker | Catalysts (Growth Drivers) | Key Risks / Headwinds | |--------|----------------------------|------------------------| | **AMS.MC** | • Global travel recovery & higher airline‑ticket volumes.
• New SaaS platform for low‑cost carriers (new ARR stream).
• Cost‑efficiency programme improving margins.
• Potential cross‑sell of ancillary data‑analytics services. | • Competitive pressure from Sabre, Travelport, and AI‑driven booking engines.
• Sensitivity to macro‑travel demand (pandemic‑type shocks, geopolitical crises).
• Currency exposure (EUR/GBP/USD) on international contracts. | | **LOG.MC** | • Expansion of automated parcel‑sorting hubs to capture e‑commerce growth.
• New fuel‑station partnership expanding top‑line.
• Diversification into “cold‑chain” logistics for pharmaceuticals. | • Regulatory risk on tobacco‑distribution margins (EU caps).
• Low ROA indicates earnings are heavily leverage‑dependent; any margin squeeze could hit profitability.
• Volatile fuel prices may affect net‑margin on fuel‑retail segment. | | **ROVI.MC** | • Positive Phase‑III data for oncology biosimilar (potential high‑margin launch).
• Strategic divestiture of low‑margin generics improves balance‑sheet and focus.
• M&A rumors could lead to a value‑adding acquisition or partnership.
• Low debt gives flexibility for R&D spend. | • Patent expiries on core cardiovascular drugs (2028‑2029) – need replacement pipeline.
• Pricing pressure from national health‑system negotiations (Spain, Italy, France).
• Execution risk on the strategic review (timing of divestitures, integration of new specialty lines). | --- ## 4. Conviction Ranking & Recommendation | Rank | Ticker | Rationale | |------|--------|-----------| | **1️⃣** | **ROVI.MC** | – Strong fundamentals (ROE ≈ 29 %, low leverage).
– Highest momentum (RSI 63, price > MA‑50).
– Clear near‑term catalyst (positive oncology biosimilar data & strategic refocus).
– Low debt gives room for R&D and possible acquisition. | | **2️⃣** | **AMS.MC** | – Robust ROE (26 %) and solid profitability (P/E 19).
– Momentum is positive and price comfortably above MA‑50.
– Travel‑industry rebound and new SaaS suite provide sustainable growth.
– Slightly higher leverage (≈ 80 % debt‑to‑equity) and competitive tech risk keep conviction a notch below ROVI. | | **3️⃣** | **LOG.MC** | – Outstanding ROE (42 %) but very low ROA, indicating earnings are leveraged rather than asset‑driven.
– Momentum is modest (RSI ≈ 50, price just above MA‑50).
– Growth hinges on logistics‑network expansion and fuel‑station partnership, but regulatory risk on tobacco and margin pressure temper upside.
– Still an attractive “value” play, but conviction is lower than the two peers. | ### Investment Take‑aways | Action | AMS.MC | LOG.MC | ROVI.MC | |--------|--------|--------|--------| | **Current stance** | **Buy – overweight** (target price +15 % over current, driven by travel recovery). | **Hold – moderate** (price near fair value; wait for clearer momentum or regulatory clarity). | **Buy – strong conviction** (target price +20 % over current, anchored on upcoming oncology launch and balance‑sheet strength). | | **Time‑horizon** | 12‑18 mo (travel cycle). | 12 mo (logistics & fuel‑station rollout). | 6‑12 mo (clinical data and strategic divestiture execution). | | **Key watch‑points** | Airline‑booking volumes, competitive SaaS adoption, macro‑travel sentiment. | EU tobacco‑margin regulation outcome, e‑commerce hub construction milestones. | EMA filing for oncology biosimilar, progress on divestiture, any M&A announcement. | --- ### Final Verdict The three screened companies all meet the quantitative thresholds, but **Laboratorios Farmacéuticos Rovi (ROVI.MC)** emerges as the strongest overall opportunity due to its blend of solid fundamentals, low financial risk, and the most compelling near‑term catalyst (positive oncology biosimilar data and a strategic refocus). **Amadeus IT Group (AMS.MC)** follows closely, buoyed by a recovering travel market and a new SaaS platform, though its higher leverage and competitive tech landscape introduce additional risk. **Logista (LOG.MC)**, while offering an eye‑catching ROE, displays modest momentum and faces regulatory headwinds that keep its conviction rank third. **Recommendation:** Prioritise allocation to ROVI.MC, allocate a secondary position to AMS.MC, and maintain a modest exposure to LOG.MC as a value‑oriented satellite.
